source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Street Where the Parade Passed
tts_text: On the main street there was one bakery and one old barber shop. Behind the counter stood Sarah, the only female baker in the town. Her brother was the only male in the family who could not cook. Within a year, everyone said her bread had become mainstream in the town. Steam rose from the big pot, and water ran down the wall in a small stream. When the oven door opened by mistake, the children outside would scream. On Sundays she added cream and butter to the dough. In summer the water in the pot would slowly evaporate. That summer, a strange germ appeared in the river. People said the water carried a virus, and bacteria from the farm had got in. Sarah had a strong immune system, but many others fell ill. A small bug bit her arm, and an insect flew into the flour. She found a worm in an old apple and threw it out. Her appearance at the town meeting surprised everyone. Some shops closed, and the small ones seemed to vanish. Sarah had to balance the books of the bakery every night. Her life and her mother's life had run in parallel lines, she said. The paradox was that the busiest week of the year was also the sickest. In October a great parade filled the street, and the whole town came out to march behind the band. For one afternoon the street looked like paradise. The sky above the roofs opened like heaven itself, though the tired shop owners called it a small hell. Two men had to heave a heavy drum onto a truck.

sentences_cn: 镇上的主街上有一家面包房和一家老理发店。
柜台后面站的是萨拉，镇上唯一的女面包师。
她哥哥是家里唯一一个完全不会做饭的男性。
一年之内，大家都说她的面包成了镇上的主流。
大锅上冒着蒸汽，水顺着墙流成一条小小的溪流。
烤箱门一开错，外面的孩子就会尖叫。
星期天她会往面团里加奶油和黄油。
夏天一热，锅里的水就会慢慢蒸发掉。
那年夏天，河里出现了一种奇怪的病菌。
人们说水里带着病毒，农场的细菌进了河。
萨拉的免疫系统很强，但很多其他人都病倒了。
一只小虫子咬了她的胳膊，一只昆虫飞进了面粉里。
她在一个旧苹果里发现了一条虫子，就把它扔了。
她出现在镇民大会上，让所有人都吃了一惊。
有些店关了门，那些小店仿佛消失了。
萨拉每天晚上都得把面包房的账目做平衡。
她说，她的生活和母亲的生活曾经是平行的两条线。
矛盾之处在于，一年里最忙的那一周也是最多人病倒的一周。
十月，一场盛大的游行占满了街道，全镇人都出来跟着乐队行进。
有那么一个下午，这条街看起来就像天堂一样。
屋顶上方的天空像天堂一样敞开了，不过累坏了的店主说这一天真是活受罪。
两个男人只好把一只沉重的鼓使劲抬上卡车。
